text: 65-year-old female. The patient is here for an annual well-check. She has a history of well-controlled diabetes and hypertension, managed with metformin and losartan, respectively. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis.

Given your age, history of sun exposure, and diabetes, the likely cause is chronic sun damage. I will now examine the lesion directly; please extend your left hand for me to inspect the dorsal surface.
